Interface Validator

All Known Implementing Classes:
TextComponentValidator
public interface Validator
A validator allows a specialized validation condition on a per component basis. If validate() is false there is no attempt to write to the data base. This is typically checked by a Decorator. .

TODO: eventually define a factory to create these, a base class might contain methods like getText.
